CustomField.description: Disable NPSP (TDTM) triggers for the rest of the transaction before merging orphaned households, so NPSP address sync does not overwrite the kept contact's address. No effect when NPSP is not installed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Disable NPSP (TDTM) triggers for the rest of the transaction before merging orphaned households, so NPSP address sync does not overwrite the kept contact's address. No effect when NPSP is not installed.
CustomField.label: Disable NPSP Triggers on Orphan Merge
